faq.title: Still have questions?
faq.ctaText: Request 30 free sample leads to see exactly what you'll get.
faq.q1: How quickly will I receive my lead list?
faq.a1: Most lists are delivered within hours of confirmation. Larger or highly specific requests may take longer.
faq.q2: Where does the data come from?
faq.a2: We use official Belgian company data from the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO), enriched with publicly available business information where available.
faq.a3: Yes. We provide company data and general business contact information only. No personal data or LinkedIn scraping.
faq.q4: Can I choose my own criteria?
faq.a4: Yes. Filter by sector, region, legal form, company age, revenue, employee count, NACE codes, and more.
faq.a5: Yes. You will receive an official Belgian invoice with VAT for every request. Payment is due within 14 days by bank transfer, or in advance if preferred.
faq.a6: Yes. Share your client list or enterprise numbers and we'll remove them from your results.
faq.a7: Your list is delivered in Excel and can be imported into most CRM systems.
faq.q8: Do you cover all of Belgium?
faq.a8: Yes. Our database contains 1,951,114 Belgian companies from the official KBO.
faq.q9: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faq.a9: Yes. Request 30 free sample leads to evaluate the data before purchasing.
